fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: Looses 3 heavy shots at once, spread apart, each dealing 12 damage and knocking the target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Cut Loose
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 32 damage, up to 2.2 times that at maximum range. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Wind in the Rigging
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 10 seconds. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Leaning Into It
fusions.desc: After you cover a stretch of ground, you regain 2 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
